notes.title: Dog Walking Adventures Post Release Update
notes.content:
Hello Dog Walkers!

It has been great seeing all of you who have purchased and given Dog Walkers Adventures a go since its full release a couple of weeks ago! I'm back with another update which addresses some much needed changes and bug fixes. This is sort of like a part 1 to a part 2, so there will be another update coming soon!



General Changes:


Removed the Phone.

Updated the visuals of Pause Menu and to display more information.

HUD now has added information including Quests, Location Discovery, and Journal Collection progress. 

When carrying your dog, you now have to hold down the interact button to drop rather than pressing it. 

Emoting now only lasts 5 seconds instead of 15. 

Removed the player button from game set up menu (for now). 

Bug Fixes

Camera no longer clips through walls. 

The carry toggle bug is now fixed due to the above change. 



Developer Notes: I could never quite get the phone to be in a place where it could actually be useful so In this update I have decided to remove it and move the information it was carrying to the HUD/ pause menu. 



That's all from me for now. Hope you are all enjoying walking you dogs! Keep an eye on this space as another update is in the works and should be deployed soon :D

notes.title: UPDATE 0.2 - STARGAZERS TRAIL
notes.content:
Hello dog walkers! It's been a while but that's only because I've been hard at work on the new map, new dogs, and of course, features and changes that you have highly requested! I hope you enjoy update 0.2 and the new map. I'm already hard at work on some smaller updates that are coming soon and of course the next big update that will come with even more new dogs and a new map! 

UPDATE 0.2.0
NEW Map: Stargazers Trail

 Journey the Stargazers Trail in Dog Walking Adventures first map set at night! There are many new locations to discover, dog quests to complete and mysteries to unveil in Stargazers Trail!


NEW & Updated Dogs

Arthur runs onto the scene as Dog Walking Adventures first Black Labrador!
Ellie the Cockapoo makes a reappearance as you can now unlock and walk her after completing her quest!

Developer Notes: There is one more mystery dog that needs to be added to Stargazers Trail. Maggie's new models and animations are also almost finished. These dogs will release soon in a separate smaller update!

NEW Puzzle Machines

Added puzzle machines to all maps. Puzzle machines are small puzzle challenges for the player to complete and solve.
Completed puzzle machines will provide rewards such as new journal entries or new dog toys!


Puzzle Changes

Removed the RC Car from Woodland Walk, Alpine Wander and Snowy Tops.
The RC Car puzzles can now be solved by playing as your dog!
Redesigned the manor maze puzzle in Snowy Tops.

Developer Notes: Some players were experiencing issues, or not quite enjoying, the RC car puzzles. But instead of removing it completely, I have reprogrammed them to work with your dog.

NEW & Updated Dog Toys

Added a new Shoe dog toy! Ready to be thrown once the appropriate quest has been completed.
Changed the look of the Polaris Plushie dog toy.


NEW Control Dog

When you whistle your dog over and interact with them, a new fourth option appears, allowing you to play as your dog!


NEW Tutorial & Updated Woodland Walk

Woodland Walk has been changed to act more as a tutorial level for new players.
Added tutorial prompts to Woodland Walk.


Phone Changes

Removed the 'Journals' App from the phone.
Added a new 'Find My Dog' App to the phone.

Developer Notes: Sometimes the dogs will get stuck on terrain, and while I am gradually fixing this issue, the new find my dog app will help get your dog back to you if it goes missing.

Main Menu Changes

Added a new 'Collections' page on the main menu which replaces the Dogs page.
The new Collections page allows the player to see all the dogs that are available in the game, as well as all the journals they have collected.
All journals are displayed in timeline order by the dates they are written.


Journals

Re-written all journals to add an underlying main story.
Made the dates of the journals easier to read.

Developer Notes: I wanted to add a larger story that's happening around the player and their dog, to give a bigger sense of adventure, exploration and mystery to the game.

Game Setup Menu

Changed the look of the dog select menu.
Changed the look of the dog toy select menu.


UI

Changed all UI button hovered and pressed sounds.
Some UI buttons now have animations.
Rewards are easier to see in quest complete panel that shows after players has completed a quest.


That's all for now! Hope you enjoy all the new features! A smaller update is in the works and should be released soon. Thank you all for playing and remember to fill out the feedback form located on the main menu of the game! Really helps a lot when developing when I know what people would love to see :D

notes.title: Update 0.1.9 - Bug Fixes & More
notes.content:
Greetings Dog Walkers! It has been one week since release and I want to say thank you to everyone who has played Dog Walking Adventures and left feedback. Leaving feedback has helped streamline development tremendously! Update 0.1.9 addresses some features/ bugs that players brought up when leaving feedback:

UPDATE 0.1.9
Dog Changes

Updated Ellie model and animations.

Quest Changes

Added a new type of quest, the 'Race' quest.

Map Changes
Woodland Walk

Added music to Woodland Walk

Alpine Wander

Added two lakes.
Added birds.

Snowy Tops

Changed Ellie walk quest to a new race quest. Race Ellie down Winter Isle Mountain!
Added a new bridge connecting the main land to Winter Isle.
Removed location 'The Great Ice'.

Developer Notes: Winter Isle was a massive area for improvement. It took the player way to long to walk up and down the Isle. Now with the Ski Lift, and the new race quest, the player can take a Ski Lift journey up and race Ellie down!

Audio
Music

Players can now mute and unmute the music that starts playing by either pressing Q, or if using controller, Right Thumbstick Button.

Sounds

Added waterfall sound to waterfalls.


Bug Fixes

Fixed dog toy boundaries in Woodland Walk. If the players dog toy goes out of bounds (i.e. into a lake or anywhere else the dog can not retrieve it), it is returned to the player and the players dog returns to them.
Fixed a bug that caused the dog and dog toy select menus to appear over the map select menu.
Fixed a bug that caused the prompt notification to appear after closing the phone.
Phone no longer appears in Polaris' hand while they are petting the dog.
Player can no longer interact with their dog while moving in a Ski Lift.


Ellie and Maggie are still not unlockable/ walkable yet but you can still do their respective quests in Snowy Tops. I've got a big update planned for the end of February so there won't likely be another big update util then, besides some smaller patches. Until then have fun walking your dogs and be sure to leave more feedback! :D

notes.title: Early Access Post Release Patch
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! Second announcement of the day! Just a small post release patch to patch a few bugs players have experienced. It's incredible that I have already received feedback from the feedback form and I am grateful to those that have filled it out. 

Patch Notes:
UI

Added a radial wheel menu with different options (pick up, emote, pet dog) after the player holds F, or the respective controller button. 
Added music information popup. When music starts playing, the song name and the author name will popup on the HUD.


Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug that caused the music to sometimes not play.
Start quest prompt no longer appears after starting a quest.
The players dog no longer freezes after player completes a fetch quest.
Fixed a bug that caused the fetch dog, like Pippin, to sometimes not move and not retrieve players toy for the fetch quest.


That's it for now! Thank you to everyone that has already purchased and played Dog Walking Adventures! I've got some excited updates in the works for the future so make sure to keep checking back!

notes.title: Dog Walking Adventures Early Access Releases Today!
notes.content:
Hello Dog Walkers! Today is the day that Dog Walking Adventures releases on Steam in early access! A big thank you to anyone who has had it on their wishlist over the past few months. Seeing the wishlist number go up over time really helped me keep my development focused and moving forward in a positive way. There are a few topics I wanted to cover as well which you can find below:

The Demo

 The demo has been deactivated but will be reactivated with a new version on 29th January. It has been deactivated for now as it is an old and outdated version of the game that no longer reflects what Dog Walking Adventures has become. 


What to expect in the First Update

 The first official post release update will release on 29th January. This first update covers some bug fixes and quality of life improvements such as new UI for interacting with your dog and a new emote function. 


Leaving Feedback

 It's very important to me that there is a clear and easy way for players to leave feedback during the early access stage of the game. In order to leave feedback you can leave a review, or in-game you can find a feedback button on the main menu that then redirects you to a Google Form you can fill out.


If you wish to follow along with development, while I will keep posting updates here, there is more content on the Code Wolf Games Instagram and Bluesky accounts.

Again, big thank you for the support and I hope you all enjoy walking your dog!

notes.title: Dog Walking Adventures Early Access Pre-release Patch
notes.content:
Hello dog walkers! Just a small patch before the game launches into early access on 22nd January! I have already planned some major updates to follow after the early access launch but for now, here is a small patch. Thank you for taking an interest in the development and I hope you are all as excited as I am for the future! :D

Map Changes:

 Added Ski Lifts to Snowy Tops.

UI:

 Updated visuals of settings menu.
 Updated images and descriptions of dogs in dogs menu.

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed performance issues when game was played at maximum quality setting.
 Fixed controller input sometimes unable to focus on main menu buttons/ widgets.
